quotes.text: You can request test results using the format 'REQUEST TEST: [test]'.
If the requested results are not in your data then respond with 'NORMAL READINGS'.

parsed.rationale: The benchmark uses a text-command protocol (REQUEST TEST, REQUEST IMAGES), so NA does not apply. S5 gives the command format and a return convention for missing results (NORMAL READINGS). There is no machine-readable schema and no read/write side-effect documentation; element_flags 1/3, with element (ii) not reaching S5.
